none: PAS BM-B4E753: BM-B4E753: Roman finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete copper-alloy finger ring dating to the second or third centuries AD. The hoop is hemispherical in section and very worn suggesting use wear. It extends to slightly expanded shoulders. The bezel is oval in plan and is decorated with a stamped inscription within a lozengiform stamped border which reads 'AVE AMA' - 'Greetings. Love (me).' The inscriptions 'Ave' and 'Ama' are reasonably common on finger rings (see CIL xiii 10024.39ff for examples). At Ribchester, a gold ring with the inscription 'AVE MEA VITA' has been found (CIL vii 1306) and a further example with the inscription 'AVE ME' found at Carlisle (JRS Iiii (1963) 163, No. 23).
